description: This file contains test cases for functions 'resolveCompactionFailureReason' and 'classifyCompactionReason', using 'vitest' testing framework. It verifies behaviors related to compaction failure reasons and their classification.

methods.name: resolveCompactionFailureReason
methods.description: Function that returns the failure reason, substituting a specific safeguard message if the reason is generic 'Compaction cancelled'.

methods.name: classifyCompactionReason
methods.description: Function that classifies a given reason string into categories such as 'no_compactable_entries' or 'guard_blocked'.
